# Security policy

## Reporting a problem

To report a problem, [open an issue](https://github.com/Jackpison/Homebase-Hub/issues/new/choose). For anything else, message [@Jackpison](https://t.me/Jackpison) on Telegram.

If you would rather report it privately, GitHub's **Security > Report a vulnerability** on this repository works too, when it is switched on.

Say which version you use (Settings > Changelog), what you found, and how to see it happen. A short example or a few steps is enough.

## Supported versions

Only the **latest release** gets fixes. Fixes ship as a new release, which you install from **Settings > Updates**.

## In scope

- The site itself: everything in the update zip (login, two-step login, encryption, backups, the pages and their API, Telegram, Tools).
- The update system: updates from GitHub and by upload, the checks on a zip, Go Back.
- The project website (https://jackpison.github.io/Homebase-Hub/) and the release files.

Out of scope: problems in your own server, PHP or host settings, and attacks that need someone who already has your website password or your server's files.

## What to expect

This is a one-person project. You will get a reply as soon as the message is read, and a fix as soon as one is ready, with no promise of a fixed number of days. When a fix ships, the changelog says what was fixed; you are credited if you want to be.
